feeds.title: Car Body Design
feeds.description: Car Body Design is an independent publication created in 2004. It provides selected daily news from the automotive and design worlds, publishes original projects created by emerging designers, links to automotive design and engineering technical publications, links to design tutorials.

feeds.title: Serge Savini
feeds.description: The 'Bête Noire' blog on Medium features a collection of essays and reflections on various topics, often focusing on culture, society, and the complexities of human behavior. The author delves into thought-provoking themes, including personal experiences, social critiques, and philosophical musings, all presented with a distinct, introspective voice. The writing often explores the darker or more challenging aspects of life, aiming to provoke deeper thought and discussion...

feeds.title: African cars
feeds.description: A showcase of Africa's rising automotive industry and vehicle makers. Jonathan Kasumba, An automotive designer consulting on different vehicle projects. Founder of the Africa Automotive Design Association. Follow this blog to get car design ideas and much more.

feeds.title: Form Trends
feeds.description: The premier vehicle design portal. Car design, vehicle design, transportation design, industrial design and the people behind the products. Follow this site to get Car Design Stories, Photos and Videos.

feeds.title: Drive Automotive Design Car Design Studio
feeds.description: Drive automotive design consultancy has established an enviable reputation for providing quality design services to major automotive manufacturers OEMs, niche vehicle and low volume car manufacturers. Follow this blog to get ideas and articles on car design.

feeds.title: Stance Is Everything
feeds.description: Few will argue that anything brings a car together better than a great combination of ride height and wheel fitment and since 2009 Stance Is Everything has been the all-encompassing stance website for Southern Ontario and abroad. With a unique generalist approach to the genre, born from a genuine love for all aspects of the automotive hobby, Stance Is Everything strives to reinforce the fact that stance is not a passing fad but rather an important part of the automotive styling and customization that has existed since day one.

feeds.title: Thoughts on Automotive Design
feeds.description: My name is Lee Walton and I trained to be a car designer at Coventry University many years ago as a result I have an MA in Automotive Design Research. Follow my blog and get ideas about car design and car styling.

feeds.title: Dean's Garage
feeds.description: Yesterday's Look at Tomorrow. 1950s to 1980s Car Design and Designer History, Studio Artwork, Designer Interviews and Quotes, Book Reviews, Videos, Racing. Follow this site to get ideas on car designs.
